jobs.title: Renewals Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

As a Renewals Manager supporting SMB and Commercial customers, you will own the commercial renewal process for a portfolio of customers, driving predictable retention and identifying opportunities for future growth. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales and cross-functional partners, you will deliver a seamless renewal experience, proactively manage commercial risk, and help customers realize continued value from their investment in Seismic.

Who you are::

* 3–5 years of experience in Renewals, Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Experience managing a portfolio of SMB or Commercial customers with responsibility for revenue retention.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to confidently lead customer conversations and achieve successful outcomes.
* Ability to identify expansion opportunities and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to support customer growth.
* Analytical mindset with experience using customer insights, product usage, and CRM data to inform decisions and prioritize work.
* Experience maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume portfolio while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative approach to working across Sales, Customer Success and Revenue Operations..
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you'll be doing::

* Own Commercial Renewals: Manage the end-to-end renewal process for an assigned portfolio, delivering timely, accurate, and predictable renewal outcomes.
* Drive Retention: Proactively manage renewal plans, identify commercial risks early, and engage customers to maximize retention and long-term value.
* Build Customer Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and position the ongoing value of Highspot.
* Identify Growth Opportunities: Recognize expansion opportunities and partner with Sales, and Customer Success to progress customer growth.
* Lead Commercial Conversations: Manage renewal negotiations and coordinate with internal teams to resolve commercial blockers and deliver successful outcomes.
* Use Data to Drive Decisions: Leverage customer insights, product usage, and commercial data to prioritize renewals, identify risks, and improve portfolio performance.
* Deliver Forecast Excellence: Maintain accurate forecasts, CRM hygiene, and renewal reporting to provide clear visibility into portfolio performance and commercial risk.
* Collaborate Across the Business: Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal to deliver a consistent, customer-centric renewal experience.
* Drive Operational Excellence: Contribute to scalable renewal processes, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer outcomes and business performance.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
IT. Developer

**About Citco**

Since the 1940s Citco has provided specialist financial services to alternative investment funds, investors, multinationals and private clients worldwide. With over 6,000 employees in 45 countries we pioneer innovative solutions that meet our clients’ evolving needs, and deliver exceptional service.

Our continuous investment in learning means our people are among the best in the industry. And our corporate social responsibility programs provide meaningful and fulfilling work in the community.

A career at Citco isn’t just a job – it’s an opportunity to excel in an environment that genuinely supports your personal and professional development

**About the Team & Business Line:**

Proprietary software solutions and innovation are at the core of what differentiates Citco in the alternative investment space. Through our network of global development centers, Citco invests heavily in technology development, security, and infrastructure to ensure our clients continue to receive award-winning products that underpin our commitment to service excellence.

As a core member of our Product Development team you will work with dedicated professionals to ensure our clients maintain access to their critical information assets while keeping Citco ahead of industry trends.

**About the Role:**

Citco Technology Management is looking for an IT Developer to develop and maintain our Web applications. You will be part of the IT department that manages the core Reconciliation platform for the firm. You will be closely working with a talented bunch of product managers, architects and developers across the globe.

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain recon applications .
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Strong knowledge of design patterns.
* Maintain working knowledge of technical enhancements and new functionality.
* Learn, adapt, test/evaluate, and implement new technologies.
* Communicate effectively with businnes and Product management teams.
* Coordinate with the DevOps team to push the application and infra changes to higher environments.
* Provide technical documentation.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD integration.
* Communicate effectively with peers and leads.
* Participate and contribute on all team activities such as sprint planning, daily scrums, and retrospectives.

**About You:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* Minimum of 3-4 years experience developing microservices using Python, AWS, NodeJS, Swagger/Open Api 3.
* Minimum of 1 years experience developing backend applications using Javascript and JSON.
* Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React and Node is a huge plus.
* Strong programming skills (Python, Javascript). Strong knowledge of design patterns.
* Experience using REST based or GraphQL APIs from single page applications.
* Have an understanding of authentication and authorization aspects for APIs.
* Have a good understanding of SQL and PL/SQL
* Any formal Cloud based training and any industry cloud related industry accredited certification is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly.
* Well rounded individual capable of performing several roles with ability to work in a fast paced, complex IT environment.

* Personal qualities: Possess a strong work ethic, self-starter, creative, a focus on customer service, possess a high level of energy, enthusiasm, excellent written and verbal communication and people skills, sense of urgency, team player, strong organizational skills, ability to multi-task, and commitment.

* Demonstrated proficiency in interpersonal and communication skills including oral and written English.
* Keywords – javascript, graphql, reactjs, python, microservices, swagger, openapi, cloud, aws, azure, gcp, git.

**Our Benefits**

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We recognize diversity as a source of organizational pride and strength. We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs.description:

In this dynamic and fast-paced environment, will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and roll out products aligned with the company’s vision and strategy. Join us in leveraging your expertise in product management to contribute to our organization’s growth and success.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience.
* Identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas to grow market share, improve customer experience, and drive growth.
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners.
* Develop product pricing and positioning strategies.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes.
* Prioritize activities based on business impact and customer needs.
* Collaborate with engineering teams for quick time-to-market and optimal resource utilization.
* Drive product launches, working with PR teams, executives, and other product management team members.

* 4 - 5 Years’ Experience.
* Proven work experience in product management
* Track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

* Solid technical background with understanding of software development and web technologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves.
* Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Role in one line: Product Manager (IC) for Apollo's internal business platforms, working with internal stakeholders across functions, 4–5 years of experience, Hyderabad, 6 days in office.

Bachelor of Computer Science (B.Sc. (Computer Science)) ,Bachelor of Engineering - Bachelor of Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) ,Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.) ,(MS or M.Tech) in Civil Engineering

jobs.description:
**Company:** Blue Ice  
**Department:** Sales & Marketing  
**Designation:** Sales Manager  
**Jurisdiction:** India  
**Reporting To:** Working Director or any other person deputed by the Director  
**Release Date:** 26 October 2026

**1. Job Purpose**

To drive sales growth, develop new business opportunities, maintain strong customer and dealer relationships, achieve annual sales targets, and ensure the profitability of orders while supporting the company's overall business objectives.

**2. General Skills Required**

* Courteous and professional communication.
* Prompt and reliable responses to customer and business queries.
* Punctuality, accountability, and dependability.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of company information.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.

**3. Job-Specific Skills**

* Thorough product knowledge.
* Annual sales and marketing target planning.
* Business development, networking, and market expansion.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of excise, sales tax, customs, and other applicable laws and regulations relating to sales and marketing.
* Leadership and team coordination.
* Familiarity with insulated truck bodies and cold-room terminology.
* Product estimation, costing, pricing, and negotiation skills.
* Computer proficiency, particularly MS Office.
* Market development and customer acquisition.

**4. Qualifications and Experience**

* **Option 1:** Postgraduate qualification with a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience.
* **Option 2:** Graduate qualification with a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience.

Relevant experience in sales, marketing, business development, or a related industry is preferred.

5. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**5.1 Sales and Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage sales activities, including customer registration, customer development, and relationship management.
* Maintain regular communication with customers and dealers to promote and secure orders for the company's Blue Ice Nirvan products.
* Identify new customers, dealers, and business opportunities to expand market reach.

**5.2 Dealer and Customer Database Management**

* Maintain and update dealer and customer information.
* Develop and maintain a database of market opportunities, ongoing projects, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Conduct market intelligence activities and share relevant information with management.

**5.3 Quotations and Order Management**

* Understand BOQs (Bills of Quantities), project layouts, and customer specifications.
* Prepare quotations and maintain relevant records and documentation in line with applicable IS standards and company procedures.
* Follow up with customers for order finalisation, execution, and collection of payments.

**5.4 Profitability and Cash Flow**

* Ensure the profitability of orders booked.
* Monitor order costs, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Support timely payment collection and maintain healthy cash flow for the smooth functioning of operations.

**5.5 Meetings and Reporting**

* Attend and participate in internal review meetings.
* Submit sales reports, business updates, market information, and other reports as required by management.
* Monitor sales performance against agreed targets and recommend corrective actions when necessary.

**5.6 Company Vision and Interdepartmental Coordination**

* Ensure that sales and marketing activities align with the company's vision, mission, and objectives.
* Coordinate with other departments to support business growth and ensure smooth organisational functioning.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams to meet customer requirements and delivery commitments.

**5.7 Policies, Procedures, and Performance Standards**

* Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of departmental policies, procedures, and performance standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies and approved operating procedures.

**5.8 Payment Collection and Statutory Documentation**

* Ensure timely collection of payments from customers.
* Collect applicable statutory forms and other required documents from customers, wherever relevant.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments for proper documentation and record maintenance.

**5.9 ISO Compliance and Documentation**

* Implement and maintain applicable ISO procedures and documentation.
* Ensure records are properly maintained and available for internal and external audits, wherever applicable.

**5.10 Regulatory Compliance**

* Monitor and comply with applicable Indian road transport regulations and other statutory requirements relevant to the company's products.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments to ensure compliance with applicable product, transportation, and documentation requirements.

**5.11 Confidentiality and Information Management**

* Maintain and update all sales-related data, customer records, and business information.
* Ensure that confidential company information is protected and disclosed only to authorised persons.

**5.12 Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform any other duties or responsibilities assigned by management from time to time, consistent with the role and business requirements.

**6. Annual Sales Target**

The annual sales target shall be mutually agreed upon between the Sales Manager and management. Performance will be reviewed periodically against the agreed targets and business objectives.

**7. Performance Evaluation Criteria**

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of agreed annual and periodic sales targets.

* Customer relationship management and retention.
* Order profitability and contribution to business growth.
* Timely payment collection and cash-flow management.

jobs.title: Team Lead Hyderabad - Drive Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager

**Your role and responsibilities**  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to define and implement sales and marketing strategies for the assigned area. Each day, you will manage the marketing and sales action plans to achieve the key qualitative and quantitative targets in a profitable way and to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by proactively leading, developing, and coaching the Marketing and Sales function.  
  
The work model for the role is: #Li\_Onsite

This role is contributing to the Motion business based at Hyderabad, India:  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:

* Creating, planning, and implementing the marketing and sales mission, vision, and strategy, along with the budget and efficiency targets for the assigned area.
* Leading the definition of the assigned division and area footprint (market presence, execution standards, and delivery model).
* Overseeing the assigned teams that identify, monitor, and maintain/exceed the sales market price levels and evaluating the pricing impact on the results with the Product Management team.
* Defining key marketing and sales targets (e.g., volume, prices, portfolio mix) and establishing appropriate metrics and measurement tools to monitor performance.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Qualification: BE/BTech above 12 Years experience
* Good knowledge on the Drive Distribution Market
* Good knowledge on the Drives & Automation is preferred
* Aggressive and result oriented, should know to sell volumes and values.
* Good communication skills
* To lead local sales team and achieve the sales target - Drive Products division. Regular review of performance of Sales Team and ensure to achieve the business growth.
* Focus on Channel Partners / OEMs / EU/ System Integrators Market.
* Look for new customer, opportunity untapped by ABB.
* Achieve the order target month on month and collect the overdue in time.
* Team handling Experience

**More about us**  
  
ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.  
  
**We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit** **www.abb.com** **to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory**

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft is building the future of AI-powered work, and the **Agent 365** team is at the centre of it. We're looking for a passionate **Senior Software Engineer** to help design, build and scale the platform that lets organisations deploy, manage and secure AI agents across the Microsoft Cloud.

In this role you'll work on large-scale, cloud-native systems that use **big data, machine learning, natural language processing and search technologies** to give customers intelligent, secure and reliable agent experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, security experts and engineering teams around the world to turn complex customer needs into high-quality solutions on **Azure, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365**.

Security and trust are at the core of what we build. You'll bring a security-first mindset, apply practices such as threat analysis and penetration testing, and help keep our services resilient and compliant. We value engineers who are curious, take ownership, engage directly with customers and enjoy solving hard problems in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

If you're excited by cloud and AI and want to shape how millions of people and organisations work with intelligent agents, we'd love to hear from you.

 **Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a scenario.

* Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform.

* Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI).

* Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items.

* Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate.

* Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of professional software development experience.
* Hands-on experience with C++ and/or C#, along with exposure to big data, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP) and search technologies.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience in customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Cloud services (Azure, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft 365).
* Security awareness, including penetration testing and threat analysis.

**Other Requirements**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These include, but are not limited to, the following specialised security screening:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position requires passing the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A technical software engineer with a passion for cloud technologies and AI.
* Previous experience as a Software Development Engineer.
* Track record of working closely with agile, diverse engineering teams.
* Understanding of cloud, AI and other computing technologies, including business drivers and emerging trends across Microsoft and non-Microsoft technologies.
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams.
* Self-starter who enjoys tackling new challenges and working independently.
* Ability to build relationships with senior technical and business leaders.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including fluency in English.

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Manager - Data Analytics and AI Enablement will lead an enterprise analytics portfolio spanning business intelligence, reporting, advanced analytics, and insight delivery while helping the organization responsibly adopt AI/ML-enabled capabilities. This role will translate complex business needs into scalable analytics solutions, lead multidisciplinary teams, modernize data and reporting practices, and partner with business, product, data science, engineering, architecture, and governance teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

The position requires solid analytics leadership and practical exposure to predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, natural language processing, and intelligent automation. It is designed for a leader who can identify high-value use cases, define business and data requirements, guide evaluation and adoption, and partner effectively with technical specialists; it is not a hands-on AI platform engineering role.

* **Analytics strategy and portfolio leadership:** Define and execute a multi-year analytics roadmap aligned with business priorities; manage dependencies, risks, and measurable value across reporting, BI, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled initiatives
* **Insight delivery:** Lead the development, enhancement, validation, and operation of dashboards, scorecards, self-service analytics, predictive insights, and decision-support solutions that are accurate, timely, scalable, and actionable
* **Business partnership:** Work with senior business, product, operations, technology, and data leaders to translate strategic questions into prioritized analytics use cases, clear measures of success, and sustainable operating solutions
* **People leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop managers, analytics leads, data analysts, BI professionals, and business analysts; manage capacity, performance, succession, skills development, and delivery commitments

* **Applied AI/ML enablement:** Identify opportunities where predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, NLP, or intelligent automation can improve decisions, experiences, productivity, or operational outcomes
* **AI/ML use-case definition:** Convert business challenges into well-defined AI/ML use cases with expected value, data needs, evaluation criteria, human oversight, implementation dependencies, and adoption plans
* **Cross-functional delivery:** Partner with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, architects, product managers, data engineers, and governance teams to develop, validate, operationalize, and monitor AI-enabled analytics solutions
* **Evaluation and responsible adoption:** Establish business acceptance criteria and support evaluation of analytical and AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, traceability, fairness, and operational usefulness
* **Governance and controls:** Establish standards for data quality, metric definitions, lineage, access, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, responsible AI, and analytics lifecycle management
* **Operational excellence:** Monitor service levels, delivery performance, solution adoption, model or insight effectiveness, incidents, risks, and realized business benefits; drive continuous improvement and timely issue resolution
* **Executive communication:** Present complex analytical findings, options, risks, and recommendations in clear, decision-oriented language for senior stakeholders
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 12+ years of experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, reporting, technology, or related functions
* 5+ years of experience leading analytics, BI, reporting, or data teams, including responsibility for performance, capability development, resource planning, and delivery outcomes
* Demonstrated experience managing an enterprise analytics portfolio and influencing senior business and technology stakeholders
* Solid experience translating complex business needs into analytical solutions, roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Experience with SQL, data analysis, dimensional or semantic data concepts, data visualization, and enterprise reporting
* Experience with BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or equivalent technologies

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Platform Vision

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP

* Build the narrative for *why* orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders

* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention

* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing

* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date

* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.

* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders

* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either

* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences

* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)

* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)

* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)

* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns

* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)

Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently  



**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products

* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)

* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models

* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

jobs.title: Business Development & Market Intelligence Executive
jobs.description:
**Business Development & Market Intelligence Executive**
========================================================

**Role Purpose**
----------------

To generate qualified market intelligence and business opportunities by identifying new projects, architects, consultants, PMCs, decision-makers, competitors, market movements, and potential customers. This role supports sales by creating a strong pipeline of researched, qualified, and prioritised leads.

This is not a desk-only marketing job. It requires research, calling, networking, database building, project tracking, and sometimes field visits.

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

* **Experience:** 58 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate / MBA preferred but not compulsory
* **Background:** Business development, project sales, B2B sales, construction/building materials, industrial products, institutional sales, or channel development
* **Skills:** Research, calling, market mapping, relationship-building, LinkedIn use, database discipline, competitor tracking, and opportunity qualification

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **A. Market Research & Lead Intelligence**

* Build and maintain a database of upcoming and new projects.
* Identify architects, consultants, PMCs, contractors, builders, developers, institutional buyers, and key decision-makers.
* Gather project details such as project stage, location, size, consultant involved, purchase timeline, decision-makers, and possible requirements.
* Track tenders, industry portals, exhibitions, trade associations, LinkedIn, project reports, and market sources.
* Create a qualified pipeline instead of random data dumping.

### **B. Competitor Intelligence**

* Track competitor activity in target markets.
* Collect information on competitor pricing, product positioning, client base, project wins, dealer network, delivery timelines, and service complaints.
* Share monthly competitor intelligence reports with management.
* Identify where competitors are weak and where Macan/Goodluck can position better.

### **C. Lead Qualification**

* Call and verify leads before passing them to the sales team.
* Identify whether the lead has real potential, budget, timeline, authority, and requirements.
* Categorise leads as hot, warm, cold, future, or irrelevant.
* Share only qualified leads with the sales team along with proper background notes.

### **D. Sales Support**

* Support sales representatives with background research before meetings.
* Prepare customer/project briefs before sales visits.
* Help identify the right person to contact in each organisation.
* Track sales progress on leads generated by this role.
* Help revive dormant customers or old enquiries with new intelligence.

### **E. Database Management**

* Maintain a clean database of architects, consultants, PMCs, project owners, builders, customers, and decision-makers.
* Update phone numbers, email IDs, LinkedIn profiles, project status, and relationship notes.
* Remove duplicate, outdated, and irrelevant entries.
* Share weekly lead reports with management and the sales team.

**KRAs for Business Development & Market Intelligence Executive**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

**KRA**

**Measurement**

New project database

Number of relevant projects identified

  

Lead quality

% leads accepted by sales as useful

  

Decision-maker mapping

% leads with the correct contact person identified

  

Competitor intelligence

Monthly actionable competitor report

  

Sales pipeline contribution

Number/value of opportunities created

  

Market coverage

Architects, consultants, PMCs, and regions mapped

  

Lead qualification

Hot/warm/cold categorisation accuracy

**KPIs**
--------

* Number of new projects identified per month

* Number of architects/consultants/PMCs added to database

* Number of decision-makers verified

* Number of qualified leads passed to sales

* Percentage of leads accepted by the sales team

* Number of leads converted into meetings

* Number of leads converted into quotations

* Number of competitor insights submitted

* Number of old leads revived

* Monthly pipeline value generated

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

As an Associate you will support the delivery CCOR Operations Transformation Capability AI-enabled initiatives within CCOR by conducting end-to-end process analysis, process mapping, process reimagination, and operating model design. You will partner with operations stakeholders, process owners, product delivery, technology, data science, and controls teams to identify inefficiencies and define future-state workflows. You will translate business needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria to enable solution design and implementation. You will support testing, validation, and implementation readiness to confirm delivered solutions align to the agreed future-state process. You will help establish baselines and success measures to track benefits, controls, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

**Job responsibilities**

* **Develop** detailed current-state and future-state process maps using **Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0**, capturing workflows, decision points, hand-offs, exceptions, dependencies, and human interventions.
* **Analyze** existing processes to identify inefficiencies, manual effort, duplication, bottlenecks, and control gaps; **redesign** workflows to simplify operations and improve quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* **Identify and assess** opportunities for large language model-based solutions, guided pathways, agentic workflows, low-code automation, and other intelligent solutions based on business needs, process suitability, and expected outcomes.
* **Translate** process analysis into proposed future-state operating models, defining roles, responsibilities, human decision points, exception handling, quality checks, and interactions between operations and technology-enabled solutions.
* **Partner** with process owners and business stakeholders to document business requirements, user journeys, functional needs, acceptance criteria, and process-level requirements for solution design and implementation.
* **Coordinate** with operations, product, technology, data science, risk, and controls teams to validate feasibility, identify dependencies, align solution design, and incorporate stakeholder feedback throughout the transformation lifecycle.
* **Support** solution walkthroughs, user acceptance testing, process validation, and implementation readiness; **verify** delivered solutions align with the agreed future-state process and business requirements.
* **Establish** process baselines and success measures, **track** expected benefits, and **define** requirements for controls, documentation, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement after implementation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Master's degree / Post Graduate Degree from a reputed College / University
* **Experience: 7+ years** of relevant experience in business process management, business analysis, operations transformation, process excellence, or technology/artificial intelligence-enabled change initiatives in Risk, Compliance or Finance processes.
* **Process modeling:** Demonstrated ability to develop and interpret BPMN 2.0 process maps, including complex workflows, decision gateways, exception paths, system interactions, and cross-functional hand-offs.
* **Process analysis:** Strong analytical skills to assess current-state processes, identify root causes and pain points, challenge existing practices, and develop practical, simplified future-state workflows.
* **Artificial intelligence & automation awareness:** Working understanding of large language models, artificial intelligence assistants, agentic workflows, and low-code/no-code automation, including where these approaches can improve processes and where human oversight remains necessary.
* **Business analysis & documentation:** Ability to translate business problems into clear requirements, process documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, operating procedures, and implementation artifacts.
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, process owners, operations, product, technology, data science, and controls stakeholders to build alignment across teams.
* **Controls & risk awareness:** Understanding of operational risk, process controls, auditability, exception management, and the importance of embedding applicable policy and control requirements into future-state process designs.
* **Structured delivery:** Ability to manage multiple workstreams, work through ambiguous business problems, track dependencies, and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Exposure to process-modeling tools such as Lucid, Visio, Signavio, or equivalent BPMN platforms; familiarity with Agile delivery, Lean Six Sigma, process mining, or automation platforms; relevant BPM, business analysis, or process improvement certifications.
* Understanding of AI & Agentic delivery methodologies

We are seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to lead requirements, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support for Trading Platforms in the Trading and Supply domain. You will blend supply chain expertise with Agile ways of working to define, document, and validate functional solutions.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Capture business problems, value drivers, and functional/non-functional requirements and translate them into implementable functionality
* Review feasibility, risks, opportunities, and business impact across initiatives and projects
* Model processes, data flows, and technology to pinpoint current value, issues, and opportunities to improve

* Manage stakeholders and lead large design sessions to drive alignment

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated 10-15 years of Business Analysis experience in the Trading and Supply domain
* Relevant supply chain knowledge supporting Trading and Supply operations
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering and authoring BRD and FRD documentation
* Proven capability in stakeholder management and facilitating large design sessions
* Experience operating in Agile environments with Agile delivery, frameworks, and tools
* Ability to teach and align stakeholders, including Product Owners and business partners, on Agile ways of working
* Sound understanding of systems engineering concepts, data/process analysis and modeling, and products & solutions
* Competency with risk management and AI solutioning in trading platform contexts

**Nice to have**

* Agile certifications or trainings
* CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or PMI-PBA certification
* Lean Practitioner training and experience

jobs.title: Lead/Senior SRE Engineer - Dynatrace
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Lead/Senior SRE Engineer with strong Dynatrace expertise** to join our team. In this role, you will drive the implementation of DevOps and SRE practices, shape the technology roadmap, and ensure the reliability, performance, and observability of our production systems. You will collaborate closely with application teams and product owners to foster a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Help to implement DevOps & SRE practices
* Drive discussions for the technology roadmap for the SRE team
* Identify, craft, and maintain SLIs and SLOs for teams, as well as metrics such as MTTR, Lead time for change, Deployment Frequency, and Change Failure Rate
* Design, develop, and manage monitoring, alerting, operability, and observability for applications using Dynatrace, Splunk, and Grafana
* Perform performance assessments and monitoring, and recommend performance enhancements
* Enforce application teams to meet performance and availability SLAs
* Partner with product owners to manage error budget, prioritize toil backlog, and validate against team, application, and incident metrics

* Strive for continuous improvement for continuous integration & continuous deployment (CI/CD Pipeline)
* Apply troubleshooting techniques, incident management, and root cause analysis
* Encourage and build automated processes wherever possible
* Implement cybersecurity measures by continuously performing vulnerability assessment and risk management
* Manage periodic reporting on the progress to management and the customer
* Collaborate with application teams to ease their adoption of the platform, and coordinate communication within the team and with customers
* Analyze the current system and develop plans for enhancements and improvements

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related fields and/or equivalent work experience
* 5-12 years of general IT experience, including 5+ years working within DevOps or SRE teams
* Background in supporting production infrastructure
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD
* Understanding of observability (monitoring, logging, and tracing)
* Expertise in Dynatrace and Splunk
* Familiarity with a leading cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Proficiency in operating high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production
* Capability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong organizational and interpersonal skills and experience developing a culture of operational maturity
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with strategic thinking and experience troubleshooting under pressure
* Flexibility to adjust quickly to new technologies
* English B2 or higher

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst- Credit Risk Management
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Lead Business Analyst** to manage requirements gathering, coordinate with stakeholders, and oversee solution delivery in a credit risk and commodity trading setting. The successful candidate will have solid domain knowledge of credit risk concepts, excellent business analysis capabilities, and the capacity to connect business and IT teams using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

* Evaluate the risks, feasibility, opportunities, and business impact associated with proposed solutions

jobs.title: IT Project Manager - Java/.NET
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly accomplished, technically astute **IT Project Manager** with 10-14 years of professional experience to spearhead the delivery of our enterprise-grade software applications.

In this position, you will guide cross-functional software development teams delivering complex projects built on modern **Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks**. Your responsibility will be to lead the end-to-end Agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), spanning cloud-native microservices development, legacy application modernization, and API integrations.

You will oversee projects where **ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Copilot, or other AI tools** are utilized. APIs are being embedded into our Java or .NET backends to create intelligent user experiences (such as chat assistants, intelligent document analysis, or automated workflows).

You will apply the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to boost sprint velocity and code quality, while simultaneously overseeing the delivery of applications that embed these models directly into our enterprise products.

The perfect candidate has a solid technical foundation (preferably a background in software engineering or systems architecture) and holds the strategic mindset needed to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, oversee multi-million dollar budgets, and advocate for modern Agile methodologies.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Act as a highly technical liaison between developers, architects, product owners, and business leaders
* Guide the team through complex project milestones involving Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Facilitate discussions around technical debt, code quality, automated testing (unit/integration/E2E), and CI/CD pipeline bottlenecks
* Oversee dependencies and risks associated with hybrid architectures (e.g., migrating legacy .NET Framework or Java EE monolithic systems to modern, containerized cloud environments)
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior leadership and business stakeholders, providing transparent reporting on project health, roadmap progress, and technical risks
* Identify, track, and proactively mitigate risks, technical dependencies, and blockers before they impact delivery timelines
* Collaborate with Product Management to align the technical roadmap with business priorities and product backlogs

**Requirements**

* 10-14 years of professional experience in IT project management
* Expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and scaled agile frameworks (SAFe)
* Advanced proficiency in project management and collaboration tools, specifically Jira, Confluence, and MS Project
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Capability to perform capacity planning, estimating, and resource allocation in a fast-paced environment
* Understanding of Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, and RESTful APIs
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines
* Background in integrating AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Co-Pilot) into enterprise applications
* Showcase of outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value
* Skills in strong negotiation and conflict resolution
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-change environment

**Nice to have**

* Qualifications in project management: PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Qualifications in Agile: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
* Qualifications as a Certified SAFe® Agilist or Certified SAFe® Product Owner

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

jobs.description:

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution

* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee theend-to-end delivery lifecyclefor client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance, and post-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such asscope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance, and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Managemulti-project portfoliosand large cross-functional teams, ensuring collaboration across domains like engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture, and DevOps
* Own theprogram governance model (SteerCo, WSR, MSR), engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels to maintain alignment on key deliverables and risks
* Take full accountability for thefinancial healthof the client portfolio, including revenue recognition, profitability, and margin improvement
* Performbudget forecasting, variance analysis, and corrective action planning to meet financial targets
* Identify areas for cost optimization and driveOPEX reductionthrough automation, resource optimization, or enhanced delivery models
* Monitorresource utilizationand productivity metrics across multiple projects
* Serve as the primary client liaison forsenior-level relationships(e.g., Directors, VPs, CXOs)
* Translate client business challenges into actionable delivery strategies and maintain alignment with client objectives
* Regularly conductSteering Committee (SteerCo)sessions and executive-level communication to provide delivery updates and propose innovations
* Build, lead, and mentor large distributed teams of100-150+ resourcesacrossnearshore, offshore, and onshore delivery locations

* Cultivate high-performing teams and drive talent development through mentoring and coaching
* Mediate resource conflicts and escalations while ensuring delivery deadlines are met
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigateprogram risksto ensure delivery schedules and client KPIs are not impacted

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Product Manager**, **Shipping as a Service** (L24)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
