jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Cisco Meraki, our intuitive platform enables organizations of all sizes to deliver customer and employee experiences at scale. To provide best-in-class technologies to our customers, we've created an unrivaled company culture for our employees. One that is collaborative, flexible, and inclusive, and provides employees with the autonomy to develop technology that is intuitive, secure, and accessible for everyone.
  
Our Dashboard teams build and maintain our web applications, which manage millions of network devices from our cloud. Our customers use the Meraki Dashboard to monitor and configure critical IT infrastructure that serves tens of millions of people every day.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with firmware, backend, SRE, and dashboard engineers to architect, design, and build large-scale systems. You will enable connections between over a million network devices and our products. Given our large footprint, quality is our highest priority. With help from product managers and firmware engineers, you will construct intuitive yet powerful systems that will be used by customers via the Meraki Dashboard.
  
  

* Design and develop software systems and enhance backend features.
* Collaborate with engineers from backend, SRE, dashboard, and support teams to ensure seamless integration, maintain system reliability, enhance user interfaces, and provide comprehensive support for end users.
* Identify and address performance issues.
* Follow established coding standards and contribute insights to improve team knowledge.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 4+ years of experience writing production code and tests for medium to large-scale systems.
* 4+ years of experience in full-stack technologies, such as Ruby on Rails, Python, React.js, and JavaScript.
* Ability to design efficient databases and optimize query performance in a relational database like Postgres.
* Demonstrate ownership of tasks within the development process, from conception to implementation.
* A keen interest in understanding user needs and contributing to product development.
* Strong communication skills to articulate ideas clearly and work effectively within a team.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience building cloud-based infrastructure and services (e.g., web applications).
* Experience with container solutions (Kubernetes).

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI and healthcare platforms used in high-volume, time-sensitive workflows, including worklists, dashboards, reporting, scheduling, monitoring and AI decision support, for professional users who need to understand complex information quickly and act with confidence.

As UI/UX Designer, you will own the user experience for assigned product areas end to end, from workflow observation and problem framing through design, validation, implementation and post-release refinement. This is not a PRD-to-Figma role: you are expected to challenge weak workflows and influence product direction with evidence.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* End-to-end product ownership. Own assigned product areas from discovery to release: frame the problem, map workflows, prototype and validate alternatives, deliver implementation-ready designs and refine after launch.
* User research and validation. Conduct contextual inquiry, clinical shadowing, task analysis and usability testing with radiologists, operations teams and administrators, and turn findings into product decisions.
* Workflow and interaction design. Design fast, low-error workflows for expert users across dense tables, queues, alerts, statuses, permissions, forms and bulk actions, including loading, empty, error and recovery states.
* Visual craft and data visualisation. Deliver interfaces with strong hierarchy, typography and consistency, and design dashboards, worklists and monitoring views that make dense clinical and operational data easy to act on.
* Design system. Own and evolve the Figma design system (tokens, components, variants, patterns and documentation), keeping it implementable and consistent with frontend engineering.
* Engineering collaboration. Partner with product managers and React/frontend engineers from solution design through release. Provide precise specifications and review the built product until it meets the intended experience.
* Accessibility and measurement. Design to WCAG 2.2 AA, and define and track usability measures such as task completion, time on task, error rate and adoption.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

* Education. Bachelor's or Master's in Interaction, Communication or Product Design, HCI or a related discipline from a highly selective institution (e.g., NID Ahmedabad, IDC School of Design - IIT Bombay, IIT design departments, or a comparable global programme). Exceptional engineering graduates are considered only with an elite product-design portfolio.
* Experience. 5-7 years of hands-on product design in complex B2B SaaS, enterprise, healthcare/medtech or similarly demanding products that were actually shipped and used.
* Portfolio (mandatory). 3-5 case studies from shipped, complex products showing the problem, users, evidence, IA and interaction decisions, alternatives, iterations, engineering collaboration and outcome. Portfolios dominated by visual concepts or redesign exercises will not qualify.
* Figma mastery. Auto Layout, components, variants, variables/tokens, libraries, prototyping and developer handoff, with the ability to build and maintain a design system.
* UX and visual depth. Strong information architecture, interaction design, data-dense interfaces, user research, accessibility, typography, layout and colour.
* Frontend awareness. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS, responsive behaviour and component-based frontends. Coding expertise is not required.

**Good-to-have:**

* Healthcare and AI. Experience in healthcare, radiology, clinical workflow or AI-assisted products, including how to represent confidence, uncertainty and AI findings responsibly.
* Service design. Journey mapping, service blueprints and UX writing.
* Design leadership. Raising design quality through critique, reviews and mentoring as a senior individual contributor.

**Key Skills:**

Figma | Design Systems | Components / Variants / Tokens | Product Discovery | User Research / Clinical Shadowing | Task Analysis | Journey Mapping / Service Blueprints | Information Architecture | Interaction Design | Prototyping / Usability Testing | Data-Dense Workflows / Dashboards | Data Visualisation | Responsive Design | WCAG 2.2 AA | UX Writing | Design QA | HTML / CSS / React Awareness

**Why Join Daignostix:**

* UX that changes real work. Your interfaces will support faster, safer clinical and operational decisions under time pressure.
* Own the full experience. Work from workflow observation through design system, implementation and production feedback.
* Direct access to experts. Work closely with radiologists, operations, AI and frontend engineers, and company leadership.

**Job Purpose:**

  

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor — the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence.

About the team. Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. The defining tension is that you assure against standards you do not own. Architecture writes them; you verify independently and make binding pass-or-fail calls on vendor handover readiness — and that separation has to survive pressure from programmes with deadlines and from architects who will not welcome the finding. You are also the executive accountable for a vendor operating more than 30 platforms, where the operational risk is real but the levers are contractual rather than direct. Expect audit and regulatory scrutiny of the governance framework you own, and be ready to evidence a governance function of yours that withstood it.**

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions security risk and exception management at the most senior level: assess complex architectural risk exceptions, maintain the Cyber Architecture and Solutions risk register, and escalate material unmitigated risk with unambiguous clarity.
* Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions-wide metrics and security posture reporting, and present authoritative performance evidence to the CISO, ExCo and Board-level risk committees.
* Lead Cyber Architecture and Solutions engagement with internal audit, external regulators and the second and third lines of defence, evidencing design quality and governance effectiveness.
* Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics so prioritisation decisions are evidence-based rather than loudest-voice.

We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Product Manager – Technical to lead key monetization initiatives for Amazon Alexa+. This product leader owns what we build and why. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with excellent product management skills, a strategic thinker who engages deeply with engineering on architecture and technical tradeoffs, and a strong communicator with excellent cross-org collaboration skills. Experience in the following domains is preferred: e-commerce, online advertising, search, AI powered personal assistants, personalization, and generative AI powered products.

You will own the product roadmap and the input and output metrics that define success. You will spend the majority of your time on core product management, and you will additionally own the go-to-market and product marketing motion — positioning, messaging, and sales enablement — required to bring your products to internal ad sales teams and external advertiser/agency customers. **About Sugar.fit**

At Sugar.fit, we are on a mission to reverse chronic metabolic diseases—starting with Type 2 diabetes and pre-diabetes—through a data-driven, compassionate, and deeply personalized approach. Combining Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) technology, precision nutrition, and expert medical coaching, we empower thousands of users across India to take control of their metabolic health and achieve sustainable outcomes.

**About the Role**

While our user-facing app delivers the daily experience, our backend systems are the true engine behind clinical reversal. We are looking for a
**Backend-Focused Product Manager / Senior Product Manager**
to own the core platform, data pipelines, and system architecture that power Sugar.fit’s consumer ecosystem.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of high-scale B2C operations, real-time IoT data ingestion, and internal care-delivery tools. You won’t just build APIs—you will architect the foundational platforms that connect continuous glucose monitors, diagnostic partners, health coaches, doctors, and end-users into one seamless, responsive ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Core Platform & System Architecture

* **Own the Backend Roadmap:**
  Define and execute the product strategy for Sugar.fit’s core backend systems, microservices, and platform infrastructure to support rapid B2C user growth.

* **IoT & Real-Time Data Pipelines:**
  Manage the ingestion, processing, and normalization of high-frequency biometric data from Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs), fitness trackers, and diagnostic labs.

* **Third-Party Integrations:**
  Lead end-to-end integrations with external ecosystems, including diagnostic logistics providers, pharmacy fulfillment networks, payment gateways, and communication engines (WhatsApp, push notifications, SMS).

2. Care-Delivery & Operational Tooling

* **Internal CRM & Clinical Engines:**
  Build and optimize the backend workflows, scheduling algorithms, and rule engines that power our doctors and health coaches, ensuring timely, personalized interventions for users.

* **Personalization & Recommendation Systems:**
  Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to build the backend infrastructure for automated health insights, metabolic scoring, and trigger-based user nudges.

3. Scale, Reliability & Security

* **Performance at B2C Scale:**
  Partner closely with Engineering Architects to define SLAs around system uptime, API latency, data consistency, and fault tolerance.

* **Health Data Governance:**
  Ensure all backend data storage, access controls, and data-sharing architectures strictly adhere to healthcare compliance, user privacy, and security standards.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **4–7 years of Product Management experience**
  in high-scale
  **B2C consumer internet**
  companies (e.g., Health-Tech, FinTech, E-Commerce, Hyperlocal Delivery, or EdTech).
  *Candidates with 6+ years and demonstrated ownership of large-scale platform charters will be considered for the Senior PM role.*

* **Strong Technical & Backend Depth:**
  Proven track record of owning non-UI/platform products—such as API ecosystems, payment/checkout engines, order management systems, logistics/supply chain backends, notification engines, or data platforms.

* **Architectural Fluency:**
  Comfortable discussing system design, database schemas, asynchronous workflows, webhook reliability, and API contracts with senior engineers without needing to write production code yourself.

* **Systems Thinking:**
  Ability to break down complex, multi-actor operational workflows (User $\leftrightarrow$ Device $\leftrightarrow$ Lab $\leftrightarrow$ Coach $\leftrightarrow$ Doctor) into scalable, modular backend services.

* **Data-First Mindset:**
  Strong proficiency in SQL and product analytics tools to independently query datasets, diagnose system bottlenecks, and measure the business impact of platform improvements.

* **B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or a related technical field**
  (or equivalent practical engineering experience prior to transitioning into Product Management) is strongly preferred.

**Success Metrics (What You Will Own)**

* **System Reliability & Latency:**
  API response times, CGM data sync success rates, and reduction in integration failure rates.

* **Operational Efficiency:**
  Coach/Doctor productivity metrics, automated workflow resolution rates, and reduction in manual ops interventions.

* **Fulfillment & Care SLAs:**
  Turnaround time (TAT) for diagnostic bookings, device shipments, and real-time clinical escalations.

**Why Join Sugar.fit?**

* **High-Impact Mission:**
  Your work directly translates to people lowering their blood sugar, reducing medication dependency, and reclaiming their health.

* **Complex Technical Challenges:**
  Solve unique problems combining hardware (CGM sensors), real-time biometric data streams, AI-driven health insights, and human-in-the-loop clinical care.

* **Ownership & Autonomy:**
  High-trust environment where you own the problem space end-to-end alongside top-tier engineers, clinicians, and designers.

This is **not a technical product owner role** . While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on **business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, regulatory compliance, product strategy and prioritization** , rather than system architecture or technical solution design.

The Vice President, Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product capabilities and enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams. We have an exciting opportunity for you to enhance your career by innovative banking solutions.

As a Data Management Senior Associate within the Chief Data Office (CDO) Data Catalog Governance team, you ensure the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the Data Catalog while collaborating with diverse business and technology partners. You support Consumer & Community Banking lines of business, product teams, and functional partners by delivering catalog reporting and insights that enable effective metadata change management, workflow oversight, and data quality monitoring. You help shape and implement data governance strategies, promoting adoption of standards, processes, and frameworks across business domains. You maintain and enhance end-to-end data lineage across platforms, including application-level, key data element (KDE), and table/column-level lineage, ensuring traceability throughout the data lifecycle. You align lineage practices with data governance, risk, control, and regulatory requirements, contributing to the evolution of lineage maturity models and success metrics. You work closely with technology and product teams to identify and remediate data lineage gaps in the Data Catalog and partner with Data Quality and Controls teams to map critical controls to data flows. You provide governance oversight for business-owned applications, acting as a data authority to support compliant and well-managed data usage. You build strong relationships with Controls, Product, Data Owners, and Technology stakeholders to coordinate cross-functional efforts and promote consistent governance practices. You deliver insights and recommendations that support both tactical fixes and strategic solutions for data lineage and catalog issues. You continuously evaluate and champion opportunities to automate lineage collection, validation, and stewardship activities to improve efficiency and governance effectiveness.

As the Data Analyst & Modeler in the Office of Regulation and Document Governance (ORDG), you will be the hands-on practitioner who takes ORDG's policy, standard, procedure and regulatory content apart at the atomic level — clauses, obligations, controls, defined terms, cross-references and their relationships — and turns it into structured, analyzable, machine-readable data. Reporting to ORDG's Data Governance & Data Product Lead and working alongside the Data Modeler & Business Analyst and the Data Analytics Lead, you will use data-science techniques (statistical analysis, NLP, entity and relationship extraction, clustering, similarity and graph methods) to profile the estate, prototype logical and physical models, validate them against real content, and generate the evidence base that governance and product decisions are made on. You will be equally comfortable in a notebook and in a modelling tool, and will pair with Data Science, Technology and consuming platforms (FPSP, DOGMA, LRCM and the RM&C Bulletin Tool) to make sure what we design at the whiteboard actually holds up on the real corpus.

**Job responsibilities**

Decompose ORDG's document corpus at the atomic level — clauses, obligations, controls, defined terms, cross-references and citations — and build the entity and relationship views that describe how policy content actually connects.

Profile the governed data estate — completeness, cardinality, duplication, drift, orphaned references and structural anomalies — and surface findings that inform data-product design, remediation and prioritisation.

Apply NLP and text-analytics techniques (entity extraction, relationship extraction, similarity, clustering, topic modelling) to reveal structure inside unstructured policy content and translate it into candidate data structures.

Build and maintain a knowledge-graph view of the corpus — obligations, controls, defined terms, policies, procedures and their citations and dependencies — to make cross-document relationships explicit and queryable, and to underpin retrieval, impact analysis and AI grounding.

Prototype and iterate conceptual, logical and physical data models for ORDG's governed data products in partnership with the Data Modeller & Business Analyst — including entity/attribute definitions, cardinality, hierarchy and lineage.

Validate proposed models against real content at scale — loading representative samples, testing rules, measuring coverage and edge-case behaviour — and feed evidence back into design decisions before physical build.

Build reference data structures for canonical taxonomies (obligations, controls, defined terms, jurisdictions) and maintain the mappings between source content and canonical form.

Support the Data Modeller & Business Analyst and Technology partners on physical implementation — data contracts, schema binding, transformation logic, validation rules — and hold artefacts accurate as the model evolves.

Use Python and SQL as everyday tools — pandas, scikit-learn, spaCy / NLP libraries, graph libraries, notebook-based analysis — to interrogate content, prototype models and generate evidence.

Design and run experiments to answer specific product and governance questions (e.g. ‘how many obligations overlap across two policies?', ‘what is the citation graph for this domain?', ‘where does a controlled term drift?') and communicate results in a way non-specialists can act on.

Partner with Data Science on retrieval quality, extraction accuracy and model evaluation — including labelling, gold-set curation and error analysis on AI-generated structured output.

Produce the analytical artefacts that inform governance forum decisions — profile reports, coverage analyses, similarity maps, model change impact assessments — with a clear audit trail from raw content to conclusion.

Contribute to the ORDG analytics estate in partnership with the Data Analytics Lead — including estate-health signals, KPI/KRI feeds and content-level telemetry — as governed inputs into the unified analytics platform.

Support user-acceptance testing and data-quality validation for new or amended data products; capture defects, quantify impact, and re-baseline artefacts once accepted.

Work across time zones and delivery streams from Bangalore — pairing daily with governance, modelling, analytics, Technology and Data Science partners in the U.K., U.S. and India — and holding artefacts as the single source of truth across the handover.

Contribute to backlog refinement across the Define & Govern Data Products workstream: break down asks into modelling and analytical work items, estimate effort, and sequence delivery with the Data & AI Execution Lead.

Experience in a hands-on data analyst, data scientist or data modeler role — including entity/relationship modelling, data profiling and analysis on real business content.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

The Role
  
The Customer Experience (CX) charter at Myntra is dedicated to removing friction from the user journey—from app launch to post-delivery support. As a Data Analyst for the CX team, you will be the analytical engine driving our understanding of customer behavior, pain points, and satisfaction metrics. You will translate complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies that directly influence product roadmaps and business operations.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights:** Dive deep into customer interaction data (NPS, CSAT, app drop-offs, and support tickets) to identify root causes of customer friction. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide CX improvements.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis:** Build models to forecast customer behavior, return rates, and seasonal ticket volumes. Anticipate CX challenges before they occur to help operations and product teams stay ahead of the curve.
* **Visual Intelligence:** Design and maintain intuitive, high-impact dashboards (via Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker) that track core CX metrics. Make complex data easily consumable for leadership and cross-functional teams.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor industry benchmarks and competitor CX strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities to ensure Myntra remains the gold standard for e-commerce customer experience in India.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary data partner for CX leaders. Effectively communicate findings, influence strategic decisions, and align analytical outputs with operational realities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams to deploy data-backed solutions and track the efficacy of new feature rollouts.

Required Skills & Qualifications
  
We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates a strong baseline (minimum 2 years of applied experience or a solid Level 2 proficiency) across the following core competencies:
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights (2):** Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and advanced Excel. Strong ability to extract, clean, and interpret large datasets to solve ambiguous problems.
* **Visual Intelligence (2):** Hands-on experience with BI tools. Ability to design dashboards that tell a compelling story rather than just displaying numbers.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis (2):** Experience working with statistical methods, forecasting, and basic machine learning concepts to predict customer trends.
* **Market Intelligence (2):** Familiarity with e-commerce market dynamics, consumer behavior research, and competitive benchmarking.
* **Business Acumen (2):** Strong understanding of how CX metrics (like retention and lifetime value) directly impact the bottom line. Ability to balance customer delight with business profitability.
* **Stakeholder Management (2) & Collaboration (2):** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences and drive alignment across diverse teams.

### **Mandatory**

The original JD does not specify education, years of experience, or formal entry qualifications. The following requirements are supported by its stated responsibilities and capabilities.

* Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to research information, analyze customer records, identify discrepancies, and develop accurate conclusions.
* Attention to detail: Ability to maintain accuracy when reviewing licensing information, preparing entitlement summaries, and processing requests.
* Communication skills: Ability to understand requester requirements, communicate findings, and respond clearly to process-related inquiries.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders to resolve issues and complete operational activities.
* Independent execution: Ability to manage assigned work, investigate issues, and meet timelines with limited direct supervision.

* Experience identifying process improvements, workflow simplification, or automation opportunities.
* Exposure to queue management, operational reporting, or resource allocation workflows.

-----------------------------

* Am I confident researching business records, identifying discrepancies, and producing accurate findings?

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Director – Business Intelligence.

**Purpose of the role:**

The Assistant Director – Business Intelligence will provide specialist expertise in data engineering and Power BI semantic model development, creating a trusted, scalable and governed data foundation for People Analytics products. The role will own the Power BI data and semantic model layer end to end, ensuring workforce data is accessible through intuitive, natural-language experiences and fit for business use.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the Power BI data and semantic model layer end to end, designing scalable dimensional models, including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, relationships, hierarchies, calculated measures and reusable business logic.
* Design and deliver robust data pipelines, including source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, dependency management, validation, monitoring and production support, in line with required security and governance controls.
* Translate business and reporting requirements into reusable semantic models, common data definitions, KPI logic and calculation standards, establishing a consistent single source of truth across Power BI products.
* Build and optimise Power BI datasets and semantic models using Import, DirectQuery and composite modelling approaches, applying advanced DAX and SQL to improve performance, usability, scalability and reliability.
* Implement and support Row-Level Security, Column-Level Security and other access controls, diagnosing issues across the data pipeline, semantic model, dataset and Power BI report chain.
* Define and maintain engineering, governance and operational standards, including data contracts, naming conventions, documentation, lineage, refresh dependencies, CI/CD, deployment pipelines and release management.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Scientists, HRIT, Data Engineering, Analytics, Security and Governance teams, providing technical direction, challenging designs and estimates where appropriate, and communicating complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Evolve the People data platform by applying Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure, Databricks, Delta Lake, Synapse, Power BI, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, XMLA endpoints and modern data architecture principles, while mentoring engineers and enabling responsible, explainable and well-governed AI experiences.

**To be successful you will:**

* Five to ten or more years of experience in business intelligence engineering or a related technology discipline, with proven experience delivering enterprise data and analytics solutions.
* Expert knowledge of Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, datasets, measures, relationships, deployment, performance optimisation and report integration.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modelling, including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, relationships, hierarchies and reusable business logic.
* Advanced proficiency in DAX, including complex measures, time intelligence, filter and row context, calculation logic and performance optimisation, together with strong SQL and data transformation skills.
* Experience with Azure data services, Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL or equivalent technologies, including ETL/ELT processes, ingestion, validation, monitoring, Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience implementing Power BI security and access controls, including Row-Level Security and Column-Level Security, within complex enterprise environments with multiple data sources and interdependent pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience in Agile and product-oriented delivery environments, including solution design, sprint planning, estimation, prioritisation, production support, CI/CD, deployment pipelines and mentoring junior engineers and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and architectural decision-making skills, with a product mindset and practical understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI, explainability, response quality and enterprise security requirements.

You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.  
  
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

Biz Data and Analytics (BIZ D&A) drives robust business decisions through expert analysis, data democratization, and actionable insights. The Users, Partnerships, and Creators Data Products team enhances the experience of front-line strategic partner managers and support operations. This is achieved by developing scalable data products and delivering cogent insights for partner engagement, creator and consumer support, and go-to-market strategies across YouTube's various relationships with creators, brands, media companies, and distributors.

In this role, you will lead the development of our centralized reporting and analytics solutions. You will partner with Partnerships, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to translate business needs into data products, driving better decision-making at scale. You will own the delivery of these solutions while advocating technical best practices among the community of business intelligence (BI) analysts and data engineers.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

--------------------

* Develop and deploy centralized dashboards, models, and single source of truth reports to optimize partner management and creator/consumer support.
* Partner with Partnerships, Support Operations, and GTM teams to identify business pain points and translate ambiguous requests into technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Infrastructure and Engineering teams to deliver a prioritized feature roadmap that enhances YouTube's support outcomes.
* Define and implement key metrics using the D&A maturity framework, providing strategic recommendations to achieve YouTube business organization's goals.
* Foster analyst community best practices across pipelines, code reviews, and dashboards while leading technical training for business analysts.

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Customer Engagement Technologies (CET)
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**Your impact begins here**
As Lead Business Analyst, you will be the primary bridge between Commercial, Medical and Customer Engagement stakeholders and IT delivery teams. You will lead requirements management, business process optimisation, solution design and stakeholder alignment, turning business needs into compliant, scalable capabilities across Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation and connected engagement platforms. Your impact shows up in stronger healthcare professional (HCP) engagement, better field force effectiveness and a sharper customer experience.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
You know the pharmaceutical commercial landscape, you are confident in Agile delivery and you enjoy bringing business and IT to a clear, shared answer.
  
  

* At least 5 years of hands-on Business Analyst experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with a track record of delivering technology-enabled business capabilities.
* Strong business acumen across Sales, Medical Affairs, Key Account Management (KAM), Marketing, Compliance and Content Management, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable digital capabilities.
* Strong ability to translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, detailed acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications within Agile delivery frameworks.
* Hands-on Agile and hybrid delivery experience, including backlog grooming, release planning, acceptance testing to determine whether it meets its business requirements, user needs, and design specifications before being approved for production deployment or customer handoff and change management.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to engage stakeholders across business and IT, explain technical concepts plainly and build alignment.
* Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, training and business adoption.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory, validation and data privacy requirements, and a safe, ethical approach to AI.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

* Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation or similar customer engagement platforms, plus familiarity with data, analytics and system integration landscapes.

**What You’ll Do**
You will lead requirements and backlog grooming for customer engagement capabilities, working within the governance set by Product Management, Business Owners and Enterprise IT leadership.
  
  

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, leading requirements elicitation and translating needs into clear, testable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications.
* Define, refine and prioritise the product backlog with Product Owners, and facilitate decisions on scope and priorities so delivery keeps moving.
* Optimise business processes by identifying root causes, risks and dependencies, and recommend solution designs based on business value, feasibility and compliance.
* Ensure traceability from business objectives through design, development, testing and deployment, and govern the quality of requirements throughout.
* Coordinate release planning, testing and UAT with architects, developers and QA, and lead change management, training and adoption so new capabilities are used in real life.

**Who You’ll Work With**
In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the full Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders in the business and helping deliver high quality, trusted technology and environmentally responsible ways of working.
  
  
You will join Customer Engagement Technologies (CET), part of Enterprise IT – Veeva & Ecosystem. CET drives the strategy, development and delivery of connected, data-driven commercial capabilities, partnering with Customer Engagement and Medical stakeholders to orchestrate HCP engagement and support data-informed decisions.
  
  
Your closest partners will be Product Managers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, developers, QA and operations teams. You will also work with International Operations affiliates and end users, Global Business Services, Novo management.
  
  
These relationships are where the role creates momentum: you bring clarity when priorities compete, speak up when things stall, and help business and IT decide, own it and follow through.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will be trusted to work with a high degree of independence and to make your voice heard in decisions that shape products used across markets. Working across commercial, medical and technology teams, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job and through relevant learning offerings.
  
  
As Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation, you can apply new technology responsibly in your daily work. Expectations are clear, results are recognised and honest feedback helps everyone raise the bar.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn business needs into connected, compliant capabilities that help Novo engage healthcare professionals better, apply for the Lead Business Analyst role by 9 Nov 2026.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
